Plots kriging weights from a spatial model.

Source: R/show_kwts.R
show_kwts.Rd

Plots kriging weights using a fitted model and a data set with locations and predictors at which we would like to predict. Note that, if there are categorical predictors in the model, then all levels must be present in pred_data for the function to run.

Usage

show_kwts(model, og_data, pred_data, index, type = "full")

Arguments

model

is the fitted model object from splm.

og_data

is the name of the data set used to fit the model.

pred_data

is the data set that contains the locations and predictor values for which we would like to predict the response at.

index

is the row number corresponding to the row in pred_data for which we would like to visualize the kriging weights.

type

can be either "full" to plot the full kriging weights, "resid" to plot the residual/spatial contribution to the weights, or "mean" to plot the fixed effects/mean contribution to the weights.

Value

A map of the weights for the particular row (index) we are predicting for.

Examples

library(tibble)
library(spmodel)
clement_hits_pred <- tibble(launch_speed = c(NA, NA, NA),
                            plate_x = c(-1, 0, 1),
                            plate_z = c(3, 3, 3))
launch_mod <- splm(launch_speed ~ 1,
 data = clement_hits,
  spcov_type = "exponential",
   xcoord = plate_x,
   ycoord = plate_z)
 show_kwts(model = launch_mod, og_data = clement_hits,
           pred_data = clement_hits_pred, index = 3)

lake_mod <- splm(log_cond ~ temp + elev, data = lake, spcov_type = "gaussian")
show_kwts(model = lake_mod, og_data = lake,
          pred_data = lake_preds, index = 4, type = "full")
